  "edit": {"DEPTH": 6},
  "description": "Increase model depth to 6 on clean shards 0-9, keeping half batch for more optimizer steps.",
  "report_to_operator": "The latest 0.948 result used TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10', which includes fixed EVAL_SHARD=10; this is evaluation data leakage. Please confirm such runs should be excluded or a separate eval shard should be provided."
}
